book_cn: 上外版选择性必修第三册
unit_cn: Unit 1 Fighting Stress 应对压力
source: 上外版选择性必修三 Unit 1 Words and Expressions(真词,p70-71 词表);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、压力/焦虑/放松主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: Too much stress can make you feel sick and tired.
words.example_cn: 压力过大会让你感到难受和疲惫。

words.example_en: The thought of the exam filled her with anxiety.
words.example_cn: 一想到考试,她就充满了焦虑。

words.example_en: Many teenagers feel anxious about tests and homework.
words.example_cn: 许多青少年对考试和作业感到焦虑。

words.example_en: He felt frustrated when he could not solve the problem.
words.example_cn: 解决不了这个问题,他感到很沮丧。

words.example_en: She was scared that something bad might happen.
words.example_cn: 她害怕可能会有坏事发生。

words.example_en: I always feel nervous before giving a report in class.
words.example_cn: 在课堂上做汇报前我总是很紧张。

words.example_en: Just thinking about it caused her tremendous worry.
words.example_cn: 光是想想就让她极度担忧。

words.example_en: Before the speech, his stomach began to churn with fear.
words.example_cn: 演讲前,他的胃因恐惧而翻腾起来。

words.example_en: She was so nervous that she could hardly swallow.
words.example_cn: 她紧张得几乎咽不下东西。

words.meaning_cn: 惊险刺激的;令人兴奋的
words.example_en: My friend said that skydiving was a thrilling experience.
words.example_cn: 我朋友说跳伞是一次惊险刺激的经历。

words.example_en: Two people may perceive the same situation very differently.
words.example_cn: 两个人对同一件事的看法可能截然不同。

words.example_en: Worry in your mind can make you physically feel bad.
words.example_cn: 内心的担忧会让你身体上感到不适。

words.example_en: Before the test, my hands felt cold and sweaty.
words.example_cn: 考试前,我的手又冷又出汗。

words.example_en: A little anxiety may inspire you to prepare well.
words.example_cn: 一点点焦虑也许会激励你做好准备。

words.example_en: Talk to an adult about what is bothering you.
words.example_cn: 把困扰你的事情告诉一位大人。

words.example_en: Reading books took up much of my leisure time.
words.example_cn: 读书占去了我大部分的闲暇时间。

words.example_en: Getting enough sleep helps you handle stress better.
words.example_cn: 充足的睡眠能帮你更好地应对压力。

words.example_en: If there is no obvious reason for your fear, the anxiety may be too high.
words.example_cn: 如果恐惧没有明显的原因,焦虑可能就过头了。

words.example_en: Continually checking the same thing is a sign of too much worry.
words.example_cn: 反复检查同一件事是过度担忧的表现。

words.example_en: He felt so panicky that he could not take the test calmly.
words.example_cn: 他惊慌不已,无法平静地参加考试。

words.example_en: Too much anxiety makes it hard to function in daily life.
words.example_cn: 过度焦虑会让人难以正常应对日常生活。

words.example_en: It is important to recognise the emotion you are feeling.
words.example_cn: 认清自己正在经历的情绪很重要。

words.example_en: Sometimes just admitting that you are stressed can help.
words.example_cn: 有时仅仅承认自己有压力就会有帮助。

words.example_en: If the worry lasts, getting help from a therapist is wise.
words.example_cn: 如果担忧持续不退,求助治疗师是明智之举。

words.example_en: Relaxation can help reduce negative thoughts and worry.
words.example_cn: 放松有助于减少消极的想法和担忧。

words.example_en: Common relaxation techniques include deep breathing and meditation.
words.example_cn: 常见的放松方法包括深呼吸和冥想。

words.example_en: Doing yoga every morning helps me stay calm and relaxed.
words.example_cn: 每天早上练瑜伽让我保持平静和放松。

words.example_en: Some people calm down by focusing their vision on one object.
words.example_cn: 有些人通过把视线集中在一个物体上来平静下来。

words.example_en: To have a balanced life is the best way to fight stress.
words.example_cn: 拥有平衡的生活是应对压力的最佳方式。

words.example_en: You can turn to relaxation exercises to get rid of stress.
words.example_cn: 你可以借助放松练习来摆脱压力。

words.example_en: Breathe in slowly through your nose and then breathe out.
words.example_cn: 用鼻子慢慢吸气,然后再呼气。

words.example_en: Once you recognise that you are stressed, you can act.
words.example_cn: 一旦意识到自己有压力,你就能采取行动。

words.example_en: Many teens find healthy ways to cope with anxiety.
words.example_cn: 许多青少年找到了应对焦虑的健康方式。

words.example_en: Going through hard times every day can make you upset.
words.example_cn: 每天都经历难事会让你心烦意乱。

words.meaning_cn: 不知所措的;难以承受的
words.example_en: Students often feel overwhelmed when they have too much homework.
words.example_cn: 作业太多时,学生常常感到不知所措。

words.example_en: Deep breathing can help you stay calm before a big test.
words.example_cn: 深呼吸能帮你在大考前保持平静。

words.example_en: Knowing how to relax helps me stay composed under pressure.
words.example_cn: 懂得放松让我在压力下保持沉着。

words.example_en: When you are stressed, you may feel angry or frightened.
words.example_cn: 有压力时,你可能感到愤怒或害怕。

words.example_en: Stress is what you feel when you are worried about something.
words.example_cn: 压力就是你为某事担忧时的感受。

words.example_en: Worrying too much sometimes gives me a terrible headache.
words.example_cn: 过度担忧有时会让我头痛得厉害。

words.example_en: I saw a deep sadness in the lonely boy's eyes.
words.example_cn: 我从那个孤独男孩的眼里看到了深深的悲伤。

words.example_en: If you leave no time to play, you can get stressed out.
words.example_cn: 如果不留点玩的时间,你会变得焦虑不堪。

words.example_en: Relaxation exercises can help you get rid of stress.
words.example_cn: 放松练习能帮你摆脱压力。

words.example_en: If you take care of yourself, you will be less stressed.
words.example_cn: 如果照顾好自己,你就不会那么有压力。

words.example_en: When you feel low, you can turn to a parent you trust.
words.example_cn: 情绪低落时,你可以求助于你信任的父母。

words.example_en: Bring up what has been on your mind with a teacher.
words.example_cn: 把你心里挂念的事向老师提出来。

words.example_en: Worrying about things that are out of the ordinary may signal high anxiety.
words.example_cn: 为不寻常的事担忧可能是焦虑过高的信号。

words.example_en: Singing softly can help you reach a calmer state of mind.
words.example_cn: 轻声哼唱能帮你达到更平静的心境。
